Testing Extra Trees under four independent validation designs (random 70/30, 24-h blocked, strictly chronological, independent parallel B stream)
Extra Trees ranking first in 8 of 9 model-design-target combinations and first across all targets under random and 24-h blocked designs (Table S10)
High accuracy under 24-h blocking for full-scale plant (R2 = 0.830 for TMP, RMSE = 0.036 bar vs 0.43 bar range, MAE = 16.3% IQR)
Autocorrelation of hourly logged series and parallel reporting of blocked and random values
Dependence structure and divergence between R2 and absolute error detailed in Supplementary Section S6 and Fig. S17
Process conclusions stability: SRT remains first-ranked driver of TMP and water level across random, 24-h blocked, 168-h blocked, and chronological training
Critique of frozen chronological partition (fits once on 7 months, freezes for 4 months) as unrealistic for plant deployment
Feasibility of frequent refitting: hourly data reaches historian within 1 hour, Extra Trees refits in ~1 second
Monotonic accuracy improvement with shorter refit interval; daily refit reaching R2 = 0.871 (TMP), 0.580 (level), 0.574 (flow)
TMP predicted to 0.008 bar with daily refit (80% error reduction vs frozen model, Fig. S17D, Table S12)
Temporal generalisation governed by refresh schedule rather than intrinsic model limit
Deployment recommendation: refit on accumulated record at least weekly, daily when historian automated
